column1: # Simplified Chinese interface: English source string<TAB>Simplified Chinese. Keyed by the exact English text the code paints.
# Placeholders: {n} {m} {k} {n2}... a number, {s} {s2}... text kept as it is, {t} {t2}... text translated in turn.
# How to add lines: docs/dev/translations.md "Translations". Terms: docs/i18n-glossary.md. Lines of a description that the
# code draws line by line are separate entries.
# Translated by Neon (24.11.2026), checked by a blind back-translation (Sol); Lang::Zh stays `complete: false` until
# Chinese is switched on. The Chinese letters come from
# the font files pocket-ui ships (src/text_fallback.rs: Fusion Pixel 12px for Retro, Noto Sans SC for Barlow), the 6,763
# hanzi of GB 2312: a hanzi outside them falls back to the system's CJK font or is left out. Chinese has no spaces: a line
# breaks between any two hanzi (src/text.rs line_units, with kinsoku), so no space is needed or wanted between words.
